1.source: Ajissa Plains (Ajissa villages), Sacred Land (Sacred villages)
1.translation: Planícies Ajissa (vilas Ajissa), Terra Sagrada (vilas Sagradas)

3.source: '''Namekian villages''' are the settlements of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Namekian|Namekians]] on [[Special:MyLanguage/Namek|Namek]]. They come in two styles: '''Ajissa villages''' in the Ajissa Plains and '''Sacred villages''' in the Sacred Land. Their traders sell the map to the [[Special:MyLanguage/Big Gete Star|Big Gete Star]], and their warriors hold off the Gete Robots that march on them.
3.translation: As '''vilas namekuseijins''' são os povoados dos [[Special:MyLanguage/Namekian|Namekuseijins]] em [[Special:MyLanguage/Namek|Namekusei]]. Elas têm dois estilos: as '''vilas Ajissa''', nas Planícies Ajissa, e as '''vilas Sagradas''', na Terra Sagrada. Os comerciantes vendem o mapa para a [[Special:MyLanguage/Big Gete Star|Estrela Big Gete]], e os guerreiros seguram os Robôs Gete que marcham sobre elas.

5.source:
* '''[[Special:MyLanguage/Namekian Trader|Namekian Traders]]''' sell general goods. Every trader also sells a '''Big Gete Star Map''' for 16 Emeralds (4 uses).
* '''[[Special:MyLanguage/Namekian Warrior|Namekian Warriors]]''' don't trade: they guard the village, and a few more keep spawning inside its walls.
* The '''[[Special:MyLanguage/Capsule Corp Namekian|Capsule Corp Namekian]]''' has its own house inside Ajissa villages and sells treasure maps to [[Special:MyLanguage/Frieza's Ship|Frieza's Ship]] and the [[Special:MyLanguage/Grand Elder's House|Grand Elder's House]].
5.translation:
* Os '''[[Special:MyLanguage/Namekian Trader|Comerciantes Namekuseijins]]''' vendem produtos gerais. Todo comerciante também vende um '''Mapa da Estrela Big Gete''' por 16 esmeraldas (4 usos).
* Os '''[[Special:MyLanguage/Namekian Warrior|Guerreiros Namekuseijins]]''' não fazem trocas: eles protegem a vila, e alguns outros continuam surgindo dentro dos muros.
* O NPC '''[[Special:MyLanguage/Capsule Corp Namekian|Corporação Cápsula Namekuseijin]]''' tem a própria casa dentro das vilas Ajissa e vende mapas do tesouro para a [[Special:MyLanguage/Frieza's Ship|Nave do Freeza]] e a [[Special:MyLanguage/Grand Elder's House|Casa do Grande Ancião]].

7.source: Robots from the [[Special:MyLanguage/Big Gete Star|Big Gete Star]] march on the Namekian villages. While you are near a village, small waves of 1–2 [[Special:MyLanguage/Gete Robot|Gete Robots]] can appear outside it every so often (up to 3 per village) and walk toward its centre, fighting the Namekian Warriors on the way.
7.translation: Os robôs da [[Special:MyLanguage/Big Gete Star|Estrela Big Gete]] marcham sobre as vilas namekuseijins. Enquanto você estiver perto de uma vila, pequenas ondas de 1–2 [[Special:MyLanguage/Gete Robot|Robôs Gete]] podem aparecer do lado de fora de tempos em tempos (até 3 por vila) e caminhar até o centro, lutando com os Guerreiros Namekuseijins pelo caminho.

9.source: Players with the locate permission can find the nearest village with {{Command|/dmzlocate village_ajissa}} or {{Command|/dmzlocate village_sacred}} on Namek.
9.translation: Jogadores com a permissão de localizar podem encontrar a vila mais próxima com {{Command|/dmzlocate village_ajissa}} ou {{Command|/dmzlocate village_sacred}} em Namekusei.
